verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, so x86 SIMD/AMX acceleration is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only GPU and Apple paths (Vulkan on Windows, MLX Swift on iOS, a reserved CUDA backend slot) and never mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, or AMX CPU kernels.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
